content.en_US:
5x5x3. Two item lines share one progress bar, plus a separate fluid line. The two do not run at the same time.

All twelve ports are universal - power, fluid and items on every one. No need to match output tanks to compass directions.

Parallel 1/2/4/8 in the GUI. It does not raise power use, which stays a flat 10,000 HE/t x upgrade multiplier.

WARNING: coolant is cold tetrafluoromethane at 3 mB/t x multiplier x parallel x 2. It is drained whenever the switch is on, even with no input. Running out cancels the batch and the output is lost, with no message.

Changing recipe or fluid resets progress to zero. Base speed is 180 ticks per batch.

See also:
[[Ores and Mining|Addon Ores]]
[[Fluid Cooler|Fluid Cooler]]
content.zh_CN:
两条物品线共用一条进度, 另有一条独立流体线, 两者不同时运行。

并行 1/2/4/8 在 GUI 里设, 不增加耗电, 耗电恒为 10,000 HE/t x 升级倍率。

注意: 冷却剂是冷四氟甲烷, 3 mB/t x 倍率 x 并行 x 2。只要开关开着就照扣, 与有没有原料无关。冷却剂耗尽会取消当批、产物直接丢失, 且不提示。

换配方或换流体会把进度清零。基础 180 tick 一批。

另见:
[[矿物与采掘|Addon Ores]]
[[流体冷却机|Fluid Cooler]]
